title: Oath and Salt
author: Orsen Halloran
blurb: Zephyrine Blackwood, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, has spent five years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
